preconditions.name: readout_sufficient_p2_ticks
preconditions.description: Per-seed P2 ticks >= TOTAL_TICKS_FLOOR so the dispositional map is estimable. Below-floor => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a workspace verdict.
preconditions.control: P2 eval window tick count per seed

preconditions.name: readout_sufficient_train_pairs_primary_h
preconditions.description: Per-seed usable (z_t, committed_class_{t+H}) TRAIN pairs at PRIMARY_H >= TRAIN_PAIRS_FLOOR so the ~112-dim ridge map is well-posed. Below-floor => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: within-episode training pairs at primary horizon

preconditions.name: at_least_two_committed_classes
preconditions.description: Per-seed distinct committed classes >= MIN_COMMITTED_CLASSES; a classifier needs >= 2 target classes. Below => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: distinct executed committed-action classes per seed

preconditions.name: action_predictable_above_null_majority
preconditions.description: The linear readout predicts committed_class_{t+H=PRIMARY} above the label-permutation p95 on a majority of seeds. Absent this signal, compactness is not assessable (an undertrained-substrate signature, NOT a workspace null) => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: count of seeds with bal_acc_full > null_p95 at PRIMARY_H

preconditions.name: readiness_majority_seeds_estimable
preconditions.description: Readout is estimable (all floors above) on a majority of seeds; only then is a present/diffuse branch licensed. Below => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
